song.title: We speak different languages
lines: We all speak different languages,
我们都说着不同的语言，
But we get along.
但我们相处融洽。
We say different words.
我们说着不同的词语，
We sing different songs.
我们唱着不同的歌曲。
We are Chinese, Canadian,

American and French.
美国人和法国人。
We can all care for each other.
我们都能彼此关心。
We can all be friends.
我们都能成为朋友。

passages.title: New friends at the winter camp

Chen Jie
Yes, I did. I made two new friends. Ivan is from Russia and Akiko is from Japan.
交到了。我交了两个新朋友。伊万来自俄罗斯，秋子来自日本。
Miss White
That's nice. Did you talk with each other in English?
真好。你们之间用英语交谈吗？
Chen Jie
Yes. Ivan's first language is Russian, and Akiko's is Japanese. We also talked in Chinese sometimes.
是的。伊万的母语是俄语，秋子的母语是日语。我们有时也用汉语交谈。
Miss White
That's interesting. What did you do together?
真有意思。你们一起做了什么？
Chen Jie
We played games and shared jokes. We laughed a lot.

Miss White
Great! Smiling is a world language!
太好了！微笑是一种世界语言！

grammar.title: 国家、语言与一般现在时：说说人们来自哪里、做什么
points: 说国家和语言：be from + 国家，speak + 语言。Ivan is from Russia. He speaks Russian. Akiko is from Japan. She speaks Japanese.
国家和语言（国籍）要分清：China → Chinese，Japan → Japanese，Russia → Russian，Italy → Italian，France → French，the UK → English。国家名和语言名首字母都要大写。
主语是 he / she / 单个人名时，一般现在时的动词要加 s 或 es：He never gives up. He often helps people. She speaks French.
频度副词 never（从不）、often（经常）、always（总是）、sometimes（有时）放在实义动词前面、be 动词后面：He never gives up. They are always brave.
复习一般过去时：Did you make any new friends? Yes, I did. I made two new friends. make → made，share → shared，laugh → laughed。

lessons.title: 语法加油站：国家、语言与一般现在时
explain: 说国家和语言：be from + 国家，speak + 语言。Ivan is from Russia. He speaks Russian. Akiko is from Japan. She speaks Japanese.
国家和语言（国籍）要分清：China → Chinese，Japan → Japanese，Russia → Russian，Italy → Italian，France → French，the UK → English。国家名和语言名首字母都要大写。
主语是 he / she / 单个人名时，一般现在时的动词要加 s 或 es：He never gives up. He often helps people. She speaks French.
频度副词 never（从不）、often（经常）、always（总是）、sometimes（有时）放在实义动词前面、be 动词后面：He never gives up. They are always brave.
复习一般过去时：Did you make any new friends? Yes, I did. I made two new friends. make → made，share → shared，laugh → laughed。

questions.exp: 主语是第三人称单数，动词加 s。

stories.title: A Smile in Any Language
lines: Lily moved to a new school in Shanghai last month.
莉莉上个月转到了上海的一所新学校。
There was a new girl in her class too. Her name was Yuki.
她班上也来了一个新女孩，名叫由纪。
Yuki was from Japan. She spoke Japanese and a little English.
由纪来自日本。她会说日语和一点儿英语。
On the first day, Yuki sat alone. She looked shy.
第一天，由纪一个人坐着，看起来很害羞。
Lily walked over and smiled. "Hello! I'm Lily."
莉莉走过去笑了笑：“你好！我是莉莉。”
Yuki smiled back and bowed. "Hello. I'm Yuki."
由纪也笑了，还鞠了一躬：“你好。我是由纪。”
At lunch, Lily taught Yuki some Chinese words, and Yuki taught Lily some Japanese words.
午饭时，莉莉教由纪说几个中文词，由纪教莉莉说几个日语词。
They laughed a lot. Soon they were good friends.
她们笑得很开心。很快她们就成了好朋友。
"A smile is the same in every language," said Lily.
莉莉说：“微笑在每种语言里都是一样的。”

qs.exp: 故事原句：Yuki was from Japan.（由纪来自日本。她会说日语和一点儿英语。）

qs.exp: 故事原句：She looked shy.（第一天，由纪一个人坐着，看起来很害羞。）

stories.title: The Quiet Hero
lines: Every morning, Tom saw an old man in the park near his school.
每天早上，汤姆都会在学校附近的公园里看到一位老人。
The old man picked up litter and fixed broken benches.
老人捡垃圾，修理坏掉的长椅。
Nobody paid him, and nobody said thank you.
没有人付钱给他，也没有人对他说谢谢。
One day, Tom asked, "Why do you do this every day?"
有一天，汤姆问：“您为什么每天都做这些？”
The old man smiled. "I was a firefighter. I saved people's lives. Now I am old, but I can still help."
老人笑了：“我以前是消防员，救过很多人。现在我老了，但我还能帮忙。”
Tom thought about his words all day.
汤姆一整天都在想这句话。
The next morning, Tom and his friends came to the park early. They helped the old man.
第二天早上，汤姆和朋友们早早来到公园，帮老人一起干活。
Soon the park was clean and beautiful.
很快，公园变得又干净又漂亮。
"Heroes don't always wear capes," Tom wrote in his diary. "Some heroes are quiet."
汤姆在日记里写道：“英雄不一定穿披风。有些英雄是默默无闻的。”

qs.q: What does the story tell us?
qs.exp: 故事结尾：英雄不一定穿披风，有些英雄默默无闻。

passages.title: A trip to Dunhuang
lines: Oliver
Where did you go during the holiday?
假期你去哪儿了？
Binbin
I went to Dunhuang and visited the Mogao Caves.
我去了敦煌，参观了莫高窟。
Oliver
That sounds interesting.
听起来很有意思。
Binbin
Dunhuang was an important stop on the Silk Road.
敦煌曾是丝绸之路上的重要一站。
Binbin
The Mogao Caves are a treasure of Chinese culture and history. I saw many amazing paintings.
莫高窟是中国文化和历史的瑰宝。我看到了很多令人惊叹的壁画。
Oliver
Wow! I want to go there, but it's too far.
哇！我想去那儿，可是太远了。
Binbin
I took many photos. I'll show you tomorrow. You can also see the caves online.
我拍了很多照片，明天给你看。你也可以在网上参观莫高窟。
Oliver
I'll check it out. Thanks!
我会去看看的。谢谢！
Where did you go during the holiday? — I went to Beijing.

lines: Miss White

I read some stories about Zhuge Liang's life.
我读了一些关于诸葛亮生平的故事。
Miss White
Great! Zhuge Liang was a wise man and stories about him teach us great wisdom.
很好！诸葛亮是一位智者，关于他的故事教给我们大智慧。
Oliver
I read Charlotte's Web. I learnt about friendship from the story.
我读了《夏洛特的网》。我从这个故事里懂得了友谊。
Miss White
Right. It's one of my favourite stories.
对。它是我最喜欢的故事之一。
Zhang Peng
I read a story about the sea. There are so many amazing things under the sea. I want to go there and find new sea life!

passages.title: Yugong moves the mountains
lines: Long ago, between Jizhou and Heyang there were two mountains, Wangwu and Taihang.

Yugong lived behind the mountains.

The mountains were in his way, so he wanted to move them.
大山挡住了他的路，所以他想把山移走。
He worked very hard.
他非常努力地干活。
His neighbour, Zhisou, laughed and told him, "At your age, you can't do it."
他的邻居智叟笑着对他说：“你这么大年纪了，做不到的。”
But Yugong said, "If I die, I have my sons. My sons will have their own children too."
但愚公说：“我死了，还有我的儿子。我的儿子也会有他们自己的孩子。”
The Emperor of Heaven saw this.
天帝看到了这一切。
He sent two helpers to Earth, and they moved the mountains to the sea.
他派了两个帮手来到人间，他们把大山搬到了海边。
Red Flag Canal
Red Flag Canal: A modern Yugong story
红旗渠：一个现代愚公的故事
Red Flag Canal
In the 1960s, it was very dry in Linzhou, Henan.
20世纪60年代，河南林州非常干旱。
Red Flag Canal
People there had no water for their fields.
那里的人们没有水浇田。
Red Flag Canal
So they planned to build a canal to bring water.
于是他们计划修一条水渠来引水。
Red Flag Canal
They only had simple tools and had to do many things by hand.
他们只有简单的工具，很多事情只能靠双手完成。
Red Flag Canal
They worked for about ten years.
他们干了大约十年。
Red Flag Canal

最终，他们在1969年修成了红旗渠，把水引到了林州。

Title: Mulan joins the army. Writer: We don't know.

Story

Story

lessons.title: Read and write 愚公移山与红旗渠
explain: 故事的结构：Title 标题，Setting 背景（时间和地点），Characters 人物，Problem 问题，Solution 解决办法。
《愚公移山》：Setting — Long ago, between Jizhou and Heyang；Characters — Yugong and Zhisou；Problem — The two mountains made Yugong's life difficult；Solution — Yugong wanted to move the mountains away.
《红旗渠》：Setting — In the 1960s, Linzhou, Henan；Problem — It was very dry. People had no water for their fields；Solution — They built the Red Flag Canal and it brought water to Linzhou.
两个故事共同的道理：Try hard enough and anything is possible. 只要足够努力，一切皆有可能。
故事用一般过去时：lived, wanted, worked, said, saw, sent, moved, planned, finished, brought（bring 的过去式）。

stories.title: Grandma's Paper-cuts
lines: Before the Spring Festival, Mia visited her grandma in a small village.
春节前，米娅去小村庄看望奶奶。
Grandma was good at paper-cutting.
奶奶很擅长剪纸。
She cut red paper into fish, flowers and the Chinese character fu.
她把红纸剪成鱼、花和汉字“福”。
"Can you teach me?" asked Mia.
米娅问：“您能教我吗？”
Grandma smiled. "Of course. My mother taught me when I was your age."
奶奶笑了：“当然。我像你这么大的时候，我妈妈教会了我。”
Mia tried and tried. Her first fish looked like a potato!
米娅试了又试。她剪的第一条鱼看起来像个土豆！
But she didn't give up. After an hour, she made a beautiful fu.
但她没有放弃。一个小时后，她剪出了一个漂亮的“福”字。
They put the paper-cuts on the windows. The house looked bright and happy.
她们把剪纸贴在窗户上，房子看起来明亮又喜庆。
"I will teach my friends at school," said Mia.
米娅说：“我要教学校里的朋友们。”

stories.title: The Little Canal
lines: After reading the story of the Red Flag Canal, Leo had an idea.
读完红旗渠的故事后，利奥有了一个主意。
The school garden was very dry, and the plants looked sad.
学校的花园很干，植物看上去蔫蔫的。
"Let's build a little canal for our garden!" he said to his classmates.
他对同学们说：“我们给花园修一条小水渠吧！”
Some children laughed. "It's too hard. We are only kids."
有些同学笑了：“太难了，我们只是孩子。”
But Leo remembered Yugong. He said, "If we work together, we can do it."
但利奥想起了愚公。他说：“如果我们一起干，就能做到。”
They made a plan. They used simple tools, like spades and old pipes.
他们制订了计划，用上了简单的工具，比如铲子和旧水管。
They worked every Friday afternoon for two months.
两个月里，他们每个星期五下午都在干活。
Finally, rainwater ran from the roof into the garden.
最后，雨水从屋顶流进了花园。
The plants grew green and tall. Now everyone calls Leo "Little Yugong".
植物长得又绿又高。现在大家都叫利奥“小愚公”。

lines: The boy asked his dad, because he was sad.
男孩问爸爸，因为他很难过。
Can you tell me why I am smaller?

lines: Mike

Mum

是啊，去年你还比我矮很多呢。
Mike
I'm stronger too.

Mum
Yes. You do a lot of sports.

I love sports. I'm going to play football with Zhang Peng this afternoon. After that, we're going to study maths together.
我喜欢运动。今天下午我要和张鹏踢足球。之后，我们要一起学数学。
Mum

It was difficult for me, but Zhang Peng helped me a lot. I'm better at maths now.

Mum
That's great!

我有时也帮张鹏学英语。他的英语比以前好了。

Good!

lines: Grandpa
Sam, what are you doing?
萨姆，你在做什么？
Sam
I'm writing an email.
我在写电子邮件。
Grandpa
Emails are so fast. In my time, I wrote letters to my friend in Sichuan. They took two weeks to arrive!
电子邮件真快。在我那个年代，我给四川的朋友写信。信要两个星期才能寄到！
Sam
Two weeks! Emails arrive in seconds.
两个星期！电子邮件几秒钟就到了。
Grandpa
Everything is faster now. In the past it took days to visit my friend, but now I can take a fast train.
现在一切都更快了。过去去看朋友要花好几天，可现在我可以坐高铁。
Sam
That's true, Grandpa.
没错，爷爷。
Grandpa
But some things are not so good now. People spend too much time on their phones.
但现在有些事情不太好。人们在手机上花太多时间了。
Sam
Yes, but we use phones for many things. We can learn, pay and play.
是的，但我们用手机做很多事情。我们可以学习、付款和娱乐。
Grandpa
Maybe you're right. Now let's chat online with Sarah!
也许你说得对。现在我们和萨拉在网上聊天吧！
Trains were slow in my time. It took days to visit friends in other places.
在我那个年代火车很慢。去别的地方看朋友要花好几天。
Trains are much faster now.

passages.title: The past and the present
lines: A long time ago, Binbin's grandpa only wrote letters, but now he often writes emails.
很久以前，斌斌的爷爷只写信，但现在他经常写电子邮件。
Before, Binbin's grandma only read newspapers, but now she reads the news on the internet.
以前，斌斌的奶奶只看报纸，但现在她在网上看新闻。
In the past, Binbin's father rode a bike to work, but now he drives a car to work.
过去，斌斌的爸爸骑自行车上班，但现在他开车上班。
Years ago, Binbin's mother often talked to friends on the phone, but now she often chats online.
几年前，斌斌的妈妈经常和朋友打电话，但现在她经常在网上聊天。
In the Tang Dynasty, people didn't ride bikes. They rode horses.
在唐朝，人们不骑自行车。他们骑马。

passages.title: Ways to communicate
lines: Communication helps us share ideas. It brings people closer to each other.
交流帮助我们分享想法。它让人们彼此更亲近。
Now there are many ways to communicate, but in the past it was different.
现在有许多交流方式，但过去不一样。
A long time ago, people in Egypt used characters to tell stories.
很久以前，埃及人用文字符号讲故事。
Chinese soldiers used smoke to send messages along the Great Wall.
中国士兵沿着长城用烟来传递消息。
And the Romans used pigeons to send messages far away.
古罗马人用鸽子把消息送到远方。
Later, people found new and better ways to communicate.
后来，人们找到了新的、更好的交流方式。
They wrote letters on paper.
他们在纸上写信。
Then they started to communicate more quickly by radio.
后来他们开始用无线电更快地交流。
Messages were faster and more people could send them.
消息传得更快了，也有更多人能够发送消息。
Today, communication is even faster and easier.

grammar.title: 形容词比较级：比一比，谁更……
points: 两者比较用“比较级 + than”：Zhang Peng is taller than Mike. 张鹏比迈克高。

比较级的构成：一般加 er（tall → taller, strong → stronger, fast → faster, long → longer）；以 e 结尾加 r（close → closer）；辅音字母 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 er（heavy → heavier, easy → easier）；重读闭音节双写末尾辅音字母再加 er（big → bigger, thin → thinner）。
不规则变化：good / well → better，bad → worse。I'm better at maths now. 我现在数学更好了。
和自己过去比：than before。His English is better than before.；as ... as 表示“和……一样”：I'm as tall as you now!

过去与现在对比：A long time ago, he only wrote letters, but now he often writes emails. 过去用一般过去时，现在用一般现在时。

lessons.title: 语法加油站：形容词比较级
explain: 两者比较用“比较级 + than”：Zhang Peng is taller than Mike. 张鹏比迈克高。

比较级的构成：一般加 er（tall → taller, strong → stronger, fast → faster, long → longer）；以 e 结尾加 r（close → closer）；辅音字母 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 加 er（heavy → heavier, easy → easier）；重读闭音节双写末尾辅音字母再加 er（big → bigger, thin → thinner）。
不规则变化：good / well → better，bad → worse。I'm better at maths now. 我现在数学更好了。
和自己过去比：than before。His English is better than before.；as ... as 表示“和……一样”：I'm as tall as you now!
问身高体重：How tall are you? I'm 1.55 metres. How heavy are you? I'm 53 kilogrammes.
过去与现在对比：A long time ago, he only wrote letters, but now he often writes emails. 过去用一般过去时，现在用一般现在时。

stories.title: The Old Photo
lines: Amy found an old photo in a box. It was a photo of a little girl with a big smile.
埃米在一个盒子里找到一张老照片。照片上是一个笑得很开心的小女孩。
"Who is she, Mum?" asked Amy.

"That's you in Grade One!" said Mum.

Amy laughed. In the photo, her hair was short. Now her hair is longer.
埃米笑了。照片里她是短头发，现在她的头发长多了。
She was 1.15 metres then. Now she is 1.50 metres. She is much taller.

In Grade One, she didn't like reading. Now she reads a book every week.

"You changed a lot," said Mum. "But your smile is the same."

stories.title: Grandpa's Letter Box
lines: Grandpa had a wooden box full of old letters.
爷爷有一个装满旧信的木盒子。
"In my time, letters were very slow," he told Ben. "One letter took ten days to arrive."
他告诉本：“在我那个年代，信走得很慢。一封信要十天才能寄到。”
Ben was surprised. "Now I can send a message in a second!"
本很惊讶：“现在我一秒钟就能发一条消息！”
"Yes, messages are faster now," said Grandpa. "But a letter is special. You can keep it for many years."
爷爷说：“是啊，现在的消息更快了。但信很特别，你可以把它保存很多年。”
Ben had an idea. He wrote a letter to his cousin in Harbin with a pen.
本有了个主意。他用钢笔给住在哈尔滨的表哥写了一封信。
He drew a picture and put a stamp on the envelope.
他画了一幅画，还在信封上贴了一张邮票。
A week later, a letter came back. His cousin was very happy.
一周后，回信来了。表哥非常高兴。
Now Ben has his own letter box. "Faster isn't always better," he says.
现在本也有了自己的信盒。他说：“更快不一定更好。”

passages.title: The story of flying
lines: Today people can take airplanes and fly in the sky. But long ago, flying was only a dream.
今天人们可以乘坐飞机在天空中飞翔。但很久以前，飞行只是一个梦想。
How did we make it come true? It's a long story.
我们是怎样让它成真的呢？这是一个很长的故事。
Kites
About 2,000 years ago, Chinese people invented kites with wood.
大约两千年前，中国人用木头发明了风筝。
Kites
Kites showed our early interest in flying.
风筝体现了我们早期对飞行的兴趣。
Hot air balloons
On the other side of the world, the Montgolfier brothers from France flew the first hot air balloon in 1783.
在世界的另一端，来自法国的蒙哥尔费兄弟在1783年放飞了第一个热气球。
Hot air balloons
It was made from paper and cloth.

Airplanes
In 1903, the Wright brothers from the USA invented the first airplane.

Airplanes
Their first flight only lasted 12 seconds, but it changed the way we travel.
他们的第一次飞行只持续了12秒，但它改变了我们的出行方式。

Now we fly in the sky and travel to space.

Spaceships

From the sky to space, our dream of flying finally comes true.

But this is not the end of the story. Where will we go next?

Making an invention is a big project. You need to work together with others.

What does it do? Each sock has a button on the bottom. When my grandpa wakes up at night and steps on the button, it will send a message to my dad's phone.

passages.title: Medical discoveries and inventions
lines: Medical discoveries and inventions help save people's lives. Here are two important discoveries.

A medicine for malaria
Malaria is a dangerous illness. It kills many people worldwide every year.
疟疾是一种危险的疾病。它每年在全世界夺走许多人的生命。
A medicine for malaria
To fight against it, Chinese scientist Tu Youyou studied traditional Chinese medicine.
为了对抗疟疾，中国科学家屠呦呦研究了中医药。
A medicine for malaria
In 1972, she and her team discovered artemisinin.

A medicine for malaria
Artemisinin has saved many people's lives. It is one of the best medicines for malaria.
青蒿素拯救了许多人的生命。它是治疗疟疾最好的药物之一。
The first vaccine
Smallpox was once a dangerous illness.
天花曾经是一种危险的疾病。
The first vaccine
To protect people, British scientist Edward Jenner invented the world's first successful vaccine.
为了保护人们，英国科学家爱德华·詹纳发明了世界上第一种成功的疫苗。
The first vaccine
With this vaccine, smallpox was completely killed in 1980.

The first vaccine
Since then, scientists have invented many more vaccines.

The first vaccine
Today people can get vaccines for many illnesses.

The first vaccine
Today people can get vaccines in a shot, by mouth or in a nose spray.

How can I become a great inventor like them?

grammar.title: 发明的用途与提建议：use ... to do / help sb do / should
points: 说发明的用途：We use a compass to find the way. 我们用指南针辨认方向。use + 物品 + to + 动词原形。
help sb do sth 帮助某人做某事：Paper helps us read and write. 主语 paper 是单数，help 要加 s。
问某物怎样帮助我们：How does paper help us? / How does the compass help us? 主语是单数，用 does。
提建议用 should + 动词原形：You should set goals and make plans first. You should also work together.
表示需要用 need to + 动词原形：We need to share ideas with each other. We need to ask for advice.
谈将来用 will：I think we'll invent a time machine. What inventions will there be in the future?

lessons.title: 语法加油站：发明的用途与提建议
explain: 说发明的用途：We use a compass to find the way. 我们用指南针辨认方向。use + 物品 + to + 动词原形。
help sb do sth 帮助某人做某事：Paper helps us read and write. 主语 paper 是单数，help 要加 s。
问某物怎样帮助我们：How does paper help us? / How does the compass help us? 主语是单数，用 does。
提建议用 should + 动词原形：You should set goals and make plans first. You should also work together.
表示需要用 need to + 动词原形：We need to share ideas with each other. We need to ask for advice.
谈将来用 will：I think we'll invent a time machine. What inventions will there be in the future?
复习一般过去时讲历史：Chinese people invented kites. The Montgolfier brothers flew the first hot air balloon in 1783.（fly → flew）

stories.title: The Umbrella Hat
lines: Ming liked to read books on the way home from school.
小明喜欢在放学回家的路上看书。
But on rainy days, he needed one hand for his umbrella and one hand for his book.
可是下雨天，他一只手要打伞，一只手要拿书。
"I need one more hand!" he said.
他说：“我还需要一只手！”
That night, he had an idea. "I will invent an umbrella hat!"
那天晚上，他有了个主意：“我要发明一顶雨伞帽！”
He asked his dad for advice. They made a plan together.
他向爸爸征求建议。他们一起制订了计划。
They used an old umbrella, a cap and some strong tape.
他们用了一把旧伞、一顶帽子和一些结实的胶带。
The first hat fell off. The second hat was too heavy.
第一顶帽子掉了下来，第二顶太重了。
But the third hat worked! Now Ming can read and stay dry in the rain.
但第三顶成功了！现在小明在雨中既能看书又不会淋湿。
"Small inventions can solve small problems," said Dad.
爸爸说：“小发明能解决小问题。”

stories.title: Lucy's Robot Helper
lines: Lucy's school had an invention contest. The goal was to help someone at home.
露西的学校举办了发明比赛，目标是帮助家里的人。
Lucy thought about her grandma. Grandma often forgot to water her plants.
露西想到了奶奶。奶奶常常忘记给花浇水。
Lucy set a goal: "My robot will water the plants every morning."
露西定下目标：“我的机器人每天早上给植物浇水。”
She made a plan and worked with her friend Tim. Tim was good at science.
她制订了计划，并和擅长科学的朋友蒂姆一起合作。
Their first robot spilled water all over the floor!
他们的第一个机器人把水洒得满地都是！
They asked their science teacher for advice. She told them to use a timer and a smaller pipe.
他们向科学老师请教。老师让他们用一个定时器和一根更细的管子。
The new robot worked well. Every morning at seven, it gave each plant a little water.
新机器人运转得很好。每天早上七点，它给每盆植物浇一点水。
Grandma's plants grew greener than before.
奶奶的植物长得比以前更绿了。
Lucy and Tim didn't win first prize, but Grandma said, "You are my heroes!"
露西和蒂姆没有得第一名，但奶奶说：“你们是我的英雄！”

passages.title: Graduation presents
lines: Rainwater is very useful and we can reuse it. This small device collects rainwater. We can water plants with it.
雨水很有用，我们可以再利用它。这个小装置收集雨水。我们可以用它浇花。
We don't want to get the classroom floor wet on rainy days. This device holds umbrellas and keeps the classroom clean.
我们不想在下雨天弄湿教室地板。这个装置放雨伞，让教室保持干净。
This is a pen holder. It holds pens and pencils. We can put it on our desk. It keeps our desk tidy.
这是一个笔筒。它装钢笔和铅笔。我们可以把它放在课桌上。它让课桌保持整洁。
This is a plant pot. We can grow some small plants in the pot. It gives the classroom some colour.
这是一个花盆。我们可以在盆里种些小植物。它给教室增添一些色彩。
This is a bird house. We can put it in a tree. It gives birds a home. It helps them stay dry on rainy days too.
这是一个鸟屋。我们可以把它放在树上。它给鸟儿一个家，还能帮它们在下雨天保持干燥。
This is a piggy bank. It helps us save money. The piggy bank keeps our money safe.
这是一个存钱罐。它帮我们存钱。存钱罐让我们的钱很安全。
These are our graduation presents. We made them from plastic bottles.
这些是我们的毕业礼物。我们用塑料瓶做的。
Poster
Stop plastic pollution!
停止塑料污染！
Poster
Where does plastic waste go? Most waste goes into the oceans.
塑料垃圾去了哪里？大部分垃圾进入了海洋。
Poster
How long does it take for plastic to break down? Hundreds of years. A plastic bottle, for example, takes about 450 years!
塑料分解需要多长时间？几百年。比如一个塑料瓶大约需要450年！
Poster
Does plastic pollution affect our environment? Yes, it does. It affects soil, oceans, lakes and rivers.
塑料污染影响我们的环境吗？是的。它影响土壤、海洋、湖泊和河流。
Poster
It is very bad for wildlife. And it can affect our health too.
它对野生动物非常有害，还会影响我们的健康。
Plastic pollution is a really big problem.
塑料污染真是个大问题。
Yes. What can we do?
是的。我们能做什么呢？
Don't throw plastic waste away. Use it for something else.
不要扔掉塑料垃圾。把它用来做别的东西。
Buy less water in bottles. Carry your own water bottle.
少买瓶装水。带上自己的水瓶。
Buy fewer plastic bags. Take your own bag.
少买塑料袋。带上自己的袋子。
Put plastic waste in the recycle bin. Then we can change it into new things.
把塑料垃圾放进回收箱。这样我们就能把它变成新东西。

lessons.title: 比较级：变化规则
explain: 两者比较用“形容词/副词比较级 + than”：Zhang Peng is taller than Mike. Mike can run faster than Zhang Peng.
一般直接加 er：tall → taller, strong → stronger, fast → faster, long → longer。
以不发音的 e 结尾只加 r：close → closer, nice → nicer, large → larger。
辅音字母 + y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 er：heavy → heavier, easy → easier, happy → happier。
重读闭音节、末尾只有一个辅音字母，双写再加 er：big → bigger, thin → thinner, hot → hotter。
多音节词前加 more：interesting → more interesting, quickly → more quickly。
“和……一样”用 as + 原级 + as：I'm as tall as you now!
key: Zhang Peng is taller than Mike.
I'm as tall as you now!
We can communicate faster.

passages.title: The three monks
lines: Narrator
Long ago, there was a hill with a small temple on it. It had a small river at its foot.
很久以前，有一座山，山上有一座小庙。山脚下有一条小河。
Narrator
One day a little monk came and wanted to find a place to stay. He walked into the temple.
有一天，一个小和尚来了，想找个地方住下。他走进了庙里。
Little monk
Hello? Is anybody there? Oh! It seems to be an empty temple!
你好？有人吗？哦！好像是一座空庙！
Narrator
After walking for a long time, he was very thirsty. He went to the kitchen to find some water, but there was none.
走了很长时间的路，他非常渴。他去厨房找水，可是一点水也没有。
Little monk
Oh no, there isn't any water. I'm so thirsty.
哦，不，一点水也没有。我好渴啊。
Little monk
Water jars, buckets, carrying poles, pots, bowls and chopsticks! I can use them to get some water. I'm so lucky!
水缸、水桶、扁担、锅、碗和筷子！我可以用它们去打水。我真幸运！
Narrator
The little monk decided to stay at the temple.
小和尚决定留在庙里。
Narrator
Every day he carried water up the hill from the river, chanted in the temple, and stopped mice stealing things at night. He lived a comfortable life.
他每天从河里挑水上山，在庙里念经，晚上不让老鼠偷东西。他过着舒适的生活。
Narrator
After a few days, a tall monk arrived and went inside the temple.
几天后，一个高个子和尚来了，走进了庙里。
Tall monk
I walked all day. I'm so thirsty. I really need some water!
我走了一整天。我好渴啊。我真需要喝点水！
Tall monk
There's a lot of water here. What a wonderful place!
这里有好多水。多好的地方啊！
Narrator
He grabbed a ladle and drank half of the water. Then the little monk arrived.
他抓起水瓢，喝掉了一半的水。这时小和尚回来了。
Little monk
Tall monk, hello!
高和尚，你好！
Tall monk
Hello, little monk!
你好，小和尚！
Little monk
You drank so much water! I just filled the jar and you drank half of it. Now you should go and get more water!
你喝了这么多水！我刚把缸装满，你就喝了一半。现在你应该去打更多的水！
Tall monk
What? I walked all day. I'm exhausted. Why should I get water?
什么？我走了一整天，累坏了。我为什么要去打水？
Narrator
Soon they started quarrelling and, after a while, they were both very thirsty. They agreed to get water together.
很快他们吵了起来。过了一会儿，两人都渴得厉害。他们同意一起去打水。
Narrator
They had one bucket, but neither wanted to make more effort than the other. So, they put their bucket in the centre of a pole and carried the water together.
他们只有一只水桶，但谁也不愿意比对方多出力。于是他们把水桶挂在扁担中间，一起抬水。
Narrator
After a few days, a big monk arrived.
几天后，一个胖和尚来了。
Big monk
Monks, hello!
和尚们，你们好！
Little monk & tall monk
Hello, big monk!
你好，胖和尚！
Big monk
The weather is so hot, and I walked all day. I'm tired and thirsty. Please give me some water.
天气这么热，我又走了一整天。我又累又渴。请给我一些水吧。
Little monk
If you want water, get it yourself. Go down the hill with the tall monk.
想喝水就自己去打。跟高和尚一起下山去。
Tall monk
What? Why me? You can go with the big monk to the river and get water!
什么？为什么是我？你可以和胖和尚一起去河边打水！
Narrator
Soon, they all started quarrelling. After a while, they were all very thirsty, but no one wanted to get water.
很快，他们都吵了起来。过了一会儿，他们都渴极了，但没有人愿意去打水。
Little monk
One of you will be too thirsty. You will go.
你们当中会有一个人渴得受不了。你会去的。
Tall monk
One of you will want water in the end. You will go.
你们当中最后总会有一个人想喝水。你会去的。
Big monk
One of you will need water and get some. You will go.
你们当中会有一个人需要水，然后去打水。你会去的。
Narrator
Finally, the sun set, and they all fell asleep.
最后，太阳落山了，他们都睡着了。
Narrator
Later that night, a little mouse knocked over a candle. A fire started.
那天深夜，一只小老鼠碰倒了蜡烛。着火了。
Narrator
The three monks woke up and fought the fire together. They ran down the hill many times to get water to stop the fire.
三个和尚醒来，一起救火。他们跑下山很多趟去打水灭火。
Narrator
Finally, they put the fire out. Afterwards, they sat on the ground.
最后，他们把火扑灭了。之后，他们坐在了地上。
Little monk
That was terrible!
太可怕了！
Tall monk
Yes, but we got water and stopped the fire together. Otherwise, there would be no more temple.
是啊，但我们一起打水灭了火。不然的话，庙就没了。
Big monk
That's right. Now I'm really thirsty!
没错。现在我真的渴了！
Little monk
Let's all go get water together.
我们一起去打水吧。
Tall monk
I agree.
我同意。
Big monk
Me too. We should all work together!
我也同意。我们都应该齐心协力！
Narrator
After that day, the three monks knew the importance of doing things together.
从那天起，三个和尚懂得了齐心协力做事的重要性。
Narrator
Every day, they each took turns to get water and lived a very happy life together in the temple.
每天他们轮流打水，在庙里一起过着非常幸福的生活。

passages.title: Little Red Riding Hood
lines: Narrator
Once upon a time, there was a pretty little girl. She wore a little red hood. It was from her grandmother.
从前，有一个漂亮的小女孩。她戴着一顶小红帽，是她奶奶送的。
Narrator
The girl loved the hood very much. She was always wearing it, so everyone called her "Little Red Riding Hood".
小女孩非常喜欢这顶帽子，总是戴着它，所以大家都叫她“小红帽”。
Narrator
One day, her mother called her from the garden.
一天，妈妈在花园里叫她。
Mother
Little Red Riding Hood!
小红帽！
Little Red Riding Hood
Yes, Mum?
什么事，妈妈？
Mother
Here's a piece of cake and some medicine. Please take them to your grandmother.
这里有一块蛋糕和一些药。请把它们带给你奶奶。
Little Red Riding Hood
Sure!
好的！
Mother
Don't run off the path. Don't go into the woods. It's dangerous.
不要跑出小路。不要走进树林。那里很危险。
Mother
Walk nicely and don't break the bottle. Don't forget to say "Good morning!" to your grandmother.
好好走路，别打碎了药瓶。别忘了对奶奶说“早上好！”
Little Red Riding Hood
Yes, Mum. I'll be careful.
好的，妈妈。我会小心的。
Narrator
Little Red Riding Hood set off. She was so excited. She saw the woods and wanted to go inside. She forgot her mother's words.
小红帽出发了。她非常兴奋。她看到树林就想进去，忘记了妈妈的话。
Little Red Riding Hood
What's in the woods? I'd like to see the trees and the birds.
树林里有什么？我想去看看树和小鸟。
Narrator
She went into the woods. She saw a wolf.
她走进了树林，看见了一只狼。
Wolf
Good morning, Little Red Riding Hood.
早上好，小红帽。
Little Red Riding Hood
Good morning, Wolf.
早上好，狼。
Wolf
Where are you going?
你要去哪里？
Little Red Riding Hood
I'm going to my grandmother's house.
我要去奶奶家。
Wolf
What do you have there?
你带了什么？
Little Red Riding Hood
I have some cake and medicine for my grandmother.
我给奶奶带了一些蛋糕和药。
Wolf
Where does your grandmother live?
你奶奶住在哪里？
Little Red Riding Hood
Her house is far. She lives near the mountain.
她家很远。她住在山附近。
Wolf
Listen, Little Red Riding Hood. Can you hear the sweet little birds? They are singing.
听，小红帽。你能听到可爱的小鸟在唱歌吗？
Wolf
And look how pretty the flowers are! Why don't you take some flowers to your grandmother?
再看看这些花多漂亮！你为什么不带些花给你奶奶呢？
Little Red Riding Hood
Good idea!
好主意！
Narrator
Little Red Riding Hood picked some flowers for her grandmother. The wolf ran to the grandmother's house. He knocked at the door.
小红帽给奶奶摘了一些花。狼跑到了奶奶家，敲了敲门。
Grandmother
Who's there?
谁呀？
Wolf
Little Red Riding Hood. It's me, Grandmother. I have some cake for you. Open the door, please.
小红帽。是我，奶奶。我给您带了蛋糕。请开门。
Grandmother
I'm in bed. Come in.
我在床上。进来吧。
Narrator
The wolf went into the house.
狼走进了屋子。
Wolf
Good morning, Grandmother.
早上好，奶奶。
Grandmother
What a strange voice you have, Little Red Riding Hood.
小红帽，你的声音真奇怪。
Wolf
I have a cold. My throat is sore.
我感冒了，嗓子疼。
Grandmother
I'm sorry.
真可怜。
Narrator
Suddenly, the wolf jumped onto the bed and ate the grandmother. He got into the grandmother's bed.
突然，狼跳上床把奶奶吃掉了。他钻进了奶奶的被窝。
Narrator
Soon after, Little Red Riding Hood arrived at the house.
不久，小红帽来到了奶奶家。
Little Red Riding Hood
Good morning, Grandmother.
早上好，奶奶。
Wolf
Good morning, my dear.
早上好，亲爱的。
Little Red Riding Hood
What a strange voice you have, Grandmother!
奶奶，您的声音真奇怪！
Wolf
I have a cold. My throat is sore.
我感冒了，嗓子疼。
Narrator
Little Red Riding Hood went to the bed. She saw the wolf.
小红帽走到床边，看见了狼。
Little Red Riding Hood
What big eyes you have, Grandmother!
奶奶，您的眼睛真大！
Wolf
They help me see you better.
这样我能把你看得更清楚。
Little Red Riding Hood
What big ears you have, Grandmother!
奶奶，您的耳朵真大！
Wolf
They help me hear you better.
这样我能把你听得更清楚。
Little Red Riding Hood
What large hands you have, Grandmother!
奶奶，您的手真大！
Wolf
They help me hug you better.
这样我能更好地抱你。
Little Red Riding Hood
What big teeth you have, Grandmother!
奶奶，您的牙齿真大！
Wolf
They help me eat you better.
这样我能更好地吃掉你。
Narrator
Suddenly, the wolf jumped out of the bed. He ate Little Red Riding Hood. Then he went to sleep.
突然，狼从床上跳下来，吃掉了小红帽。然后他睡着了。
Narrator
A hunter came to the grandmother's house.
一位猎人来到了奶奶家。
Hunter
How does the old woman feel now? Is she better? I must go and see her.
老奶奶现在感觉怎么样？好些了吗？我得去看看她。
Narrator
He went to the grandmother's bed, but he didn't see her. He saw the wolf. He killed the wolf.
他走到奶奶床边，没看到奶奶，却看到了狼。他杀死了狼。
Narrator
Grandmother and Little Red Riding Hood jumped out of the wolf's stomach.
奶奶和小红帽从狼肚子里跳了出来。
Little Red Riding Hood
Thank you, Mr Hunter. I'll never go into the woods by myself again!
谢谢您，猎人先生。我再也不会一个人走进树林了！
Grandmother
Thank you for saving us!
谢谢您救了我们！

grammar.title: 课本剧
points: 附录5 的两部课本剧，可分角色朗读表演。

lessons.title: 课本剧 三个和尚
explain: 《三个和尚》The three monks：一个和尚挑水喝，两个和尚抬水喝，三个和尚没水喝。最后一场火让他们明白了齐心协力的重要。
重点表达：carry water 挑水，take turns 轮流，quarrel 争吵，put the fire out 把火扑灭，work together 齐心协力。
一般过去时贯穿全剧：came, walked, went, drank, fell asleep, knocked over, woke up, fought, ran, sat, took turns。
there was none 一点也没有；neither wanted to ... 两个都不愿意……；Otherwise, there would be no more temple. 否则庙就没了。
key: Oh no, there isn't any water. I'm so thirsty.
They agreed to get water together.
We should all work together!
They each took turns to get water.

questions.q: Who came to the temple first?
questions.exp: 小和尚最先来到庙里：One day a little monk came ... He walked into the temple.

questions.q: What did the tall monk do with the water?
opts: He gave it to the big monk.
questions.exp: 课文原句：He grabbed a ladle and drank half of the water.（他抓起水瓢，喝掉了一半的水。这时小和尚回来了。）

questions.q: How did the little monk and the tall monk carry water?
opts: They put the bucket in the centre of a pole and carried it together.
questions.exp: 课文原句：they put their bucket in the centre of a pole and carried the water together.（他们只有一只水桶，但谁也不愿意比对方多出力。于是他们把水桶挂在扁担中间，一起抬水。）

questions.q: What started the fire?
opts: A little mouse knocked over a candle.
questions.exp: 课文原句：a little mouse knocked over a candle. A fire started.（那天深夜，一只小老鼠碰倒了蜡烛。着火了。）

questions.q: What did the three monks learn?
opts: the importance of doing things together
questions.exp: 课文原句：the three monks knew the importance of doing things together.（从那天起，三个和尚懂得了齐心协力做事的重要性。）

questions.q: They ___ the fire together.
questions.exp: fight 的过去式是 fought。

questions.q: After that day, they each took ___ to get water.
questions.exp: take turns 轮流。

lessons.title: 课本剧 小红帽
explain: 《小红帽》Little Red Riding Hood：小红帽给奶奶送蛋糕和药，没听妈妈的话走进树林，被狼骗了。最后猎人救了她和奶奶。
妈妈的叮嘱用祈使句：Don't run off the path. Don't go into the woods. Walk nicely. Don't forget to say "Good morning!"
感叹句：What big eyes you have! What a strange voice you have!（What + (a) + 形容词 + 名词 + 主语 + 谓语！）
help sb do：They help me see you better. better 是 well 的比较级。
结尾：I'll never go into the woods by myself again! by myself 独自。
key: Don't go into the woods. It's dangerous.
What big eyes you have, Grandmother!
They help me see you better.
I'll never go into the woods by myself again!

questions.q: What did Little Red Riding Hood take to her grandmother?
questions.exp: 课文原句：Here's a piece of cake and some medicine. Please take them to your grandmother.（这里有一块蛋糕和一些药。请把它们带给你奶奶。）

questions.q: Why was she called "Little Red Riding Hood"?
opts: She always wore a little red hood.
questions.exp: 课文原句：She was always wearing it, so everyone called her "Little Red Riding Hood".（小女孩非常喜欢这顶帽子，总是戴着它，所以大家都叫她“小红帽”。…小红帽！）

questions.q: What did the wolf tell her to do?
opts: pick some flowers for her grandmother
questions.exp: 课文原句：Why don't you take some flowers to your grandmother?（再看看这些花多漂亮！你为什么不带些花给你奶奶呢？）

questions.q: Who saved Grandmother and Little Red Riding Hood?
questions.exp: 猎人杀死了狼，救了她们：A hunter came ... He killed the wolf.

questions.q: —What big ears you have, Grandmother! —They help me ___ you better.
questions.exp: 耳朵用来听 hear。

questions.q: Don't ___ into the woods.
questions.exp: 否定祈使句：Don't + 动词原形。

questions.q: She ___ her mother's words.
questions.exp: forget 的过去式是 forgot。
